injection_evidence.explanation: The single correct mode=insert_fatal/thread=0/team=2/batch=1 marker is prefixed by stderr text EONSim rank, so records(), which requires a line-start marker, discards it. Fatal injection and propagation occurred; this is diagnostic publication/interleaving, not changed FSI acceptance semantics or reference-coordinate metadata.
injection_evidence.minimal_fix: Flush the complete marker before rethrow into collective fatal error propagation; preserve existing parser and acceptance gates.
